stem: One irrigation zone repeatedly shows clogged emitters beyond the routine correction allowed by procedure. What should Technician I do?
choices: Increase pressure beyond the work order
Stop documenting after the first occurrence
Document recurrence and affected zone and escalate the unresolved equipment/delivery fault
rationale: Document recurrence and affected zone and escalate the unresolved equipment/delivery fault. This preserves the Course 004 measurement, root-zone, nutrition, work-order, equipment or record-quality principle being assessed.
